# RC1-10 v1.0.1 repair notes

This repair supersedes RC1-10 v1.0.0 for the security hardening stage.

## Fixes

1. Corrects the PowerShell regex used to match `BUILTIN\Users`.
2. Persists the ACL rollback file **before** applying any ACL change.
3. Adds automatic ACL rollback if a later hardening operation fails.
4. Explicitly loads `System.Security` for Windows PowerShell 5.1 DPAPI compatibility.
5. Adds a real LocalMachine DPAPI round-trip probe before quarantining any secret file.
6. Quarantine now prints source path + exception text on failure, never secret values.
7. Quarantine deletes a plaintext legacy copy only after encrypted backup/decrypt/hash verification succeeds.
8. Adds a Windows PowerShell parser gate to the repair workflow.

## Existing VPS state

Do not reinstall RC1-08 or RC1-09.
Do not reboot for this repair.
Do not answer YES to the cTrader secret-rotation attestation until the exposed credential has actually been replaced.
